description: How each sector ETF performs against the S&P 500 (SPY), placed in four quadrants by its 3-month (X) and 1-month (Y) change vs SPY: Outperformers (ahead on both), Emerging (behind over 3 months, ahead over 1 month), Cooling (ahead over 3 months, behind over 1 month) and Underperformers (behind on both). Also gives short-term momentum, relative-strength trend and returns over 1w to 1y. Free access covers the 11 broad S&P 500 sectors; Premium adds 104 thematic and industry sectors. Use zensei_sector_detail for one sector's holdings.
name: zensei_sectors_scan
title: Sector scan
